concepts.name: Sliding Window Limiter
concepts.description: Rate limiting that keeps the timestamps of recent requests per key and allows a request only if fewer than LIMIT fall inside the last WINDOW_MS. The window moves with the clock, so there is no reset boundary burst as in fixed windows.
concepts.context: allow() in src/limit.ts filters each key's timestamps to those within WINDOW_MS of now, rejects when fresh.length >= LIMIT, otherwise pushes now

concepts.name: In-Memory Per-Key State
concepts.description: Holding per-client state in a process-local Map keyed by an identifier. It is fast and simple, but it is lost on restart and not shared across instances, so a multi-instance deployment needs a shared store such as Redis.

concepts.name: Injectable Clock
concepts.description: Passing the current time in as a parameter with a default, instead of reading the clock inside the function. Tests can then supply fixed timestamps and get deterministic results without fake timers.
concepts.context: allow(key, now = Date.now()) in src/limit.ts takes now as a defaulted argument so the window logic can be tested with explicit times

concepts.name: Stale Entry Pruning
concepts.description: Discarding expired entries so stored state does not grow without bound. Filtering a key's timestamps on each call bounds that key's array, but keys that are never seen again stay in the map forever unless they are swept.
